unit.why: A short first-person memorate from Megillat Setarim: the narrator stands with his late holy uncle R. Zvi, who reveals that the Besht is again in the world, and the narrator is astonished. It is a minimal narrative of an encounter, not a bare saying.
unit.boundary_note: One of a numbered series of visionary diary entries ((כג) before, (כה) after); this entry is self-contained.

stories.end_quote: ואינו יודע היכן הוא ותמהתי עליו
stories.summary_en: In a vision or dream, R. Yitzhak Isaac of Komarno stands beside his deceased uncle R. Zvi, who tells him that the Baal Shem Tov is back in the world, several levels greater in the light of yihudim, but that he does not know where he is; the narrator is astonished.
